Name options: REPBRAWL (used), SWEATDOWN, FLEXFIGHT.

The whole game is in index.html: camera and plank check, push-up counter, 60-second battle, XP/coins/streak saving, the other three exercises, league, themes and challenge mode. I haven’t run it on a phone, so test it there before relying on it. The camera only works over HTTPS, so open it from your GitHub Pages link rather than as a local file.

Put it online free with GitHub Pages

  1. Sign in at github.com (create a free account if needed).
  2. Tap + at the top right, then New repository. Name it repbrawl, set it to Public, and tap Create repository.
  3. Tap uploading an existing file, drag in index.html, and tap Commit changes.
  4. Open Settings, then Pages.
  5. Under Branch, choose main and / (root), then tap Save.
  6. Wait about a minute and refresh. The page shows your link: https://YOURNAME.github.io/repbrawl/.

Open it on your phone

  1. Type that link into Chrome (Android) or Safari (iPhone), or text it to yourself.
  2. Tap Allow when asked for camera access. If it’s blocked, tap the lock icon in the address bar, set Camera to Allow, and reload.
  3. For a home-screen icon, use Add to Home Screen (Chrome menu, or Safari’s Share button).
